messages:
marta_cs: Emberfield requested onboarding for a custom 14B summarizer that will touch PHI. they need HSM support and a 200ms p95 latency target. renewal in 2 weeks, so this is high priority.
leah_pm: @marta_cs thanks — can you paste their exact security reqs and expected qps? we should capture renewal risk in the account health doc.
devon_se: want the model spec + sample prompt set. also, do they need private (VPC) or on-prem? HSM makes me think private.
marta_cs: copying the ask from the customer: "onboard 14B summarizer, PHI token redaction, KMS/HSM key wrapping, SOC2, p95 <=200ms, steady 50 qps with 200 qps bursts". they asked for an enablement session next week.
sanjay_infra: @devon_se @leah_pm PHI + HSM => Private deployment likely. we need sizing for 50 qps steady; rough calc: cluster of 4xA10G for 14B quantized + KV cache. will validate.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: DR-8721. CI checks pending. link: https://deploys.internal/DR-8721
leah_pm: we should run a safety eval on their sample dataset (PII, edge cases). @marta_cs can you get their eval set by EOD Wed? label schema needed.
marta_cs: yes I'll request the eval set and the prompt bank. I'll also ask for any SLA language they want for renewal negotiation.
devon_se: for the eval plan — propose: (1) redaction test, (2) hallucination regression on legal/medical prompts, (3) latency under load. small harness:```python
# run locally against preprod
for prompt in prompts:
    resp = client.generate(model="ember-14B-v1", prompt=prompt)
    check_redaction(resp)
```
leah_pm: capture feedback loop: track customer satisfaction after enablement + any safety flags in ops console. add as renewal trigger if issues found.
sanjay_infra: I'll draft infra sizing and estimate cost delta for private+HSM. ETA tomorrow noon.
marta_cs: awesome — action items: I) get eval set (marta) II) infra estimate (sanjay) III) safety eval harness (devon) IV) schedule enablement (leah). renewal owner: leah.
leah_pm: putting a 30-min slot on calendar next Tue 11am for a kickoff. invite Emberfield CSM + security.
marta_cs: thanks everyone — I'll update account health doc and flag renewal risk to AM. :white_check_mark:
